title: Med3D-R1: Incentivizing Clinical Reasoning in 3D Medical Vision-Language Models for Abnormality Diagnosis

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the asymmetric distribution of normal versus abnormal sentences in radiology reports (where normal findings predominantly appear early and abnormal findings later) and evaluating model performance using an Abnormality Re-Weighting (ARW) strategy during Supervised Fine-Tuning to counteract the model's tendency to default to early normal predictions.
